name: IaC Drift Agent
stats: 1.000 precision vs 0.325 · 8.3 false alarms per scan eliminated · 26 tests
content: IaC Drift Agent (AI Agents): "Drift alerts you can actually trust.". A plain diff raises about 8 false alarms per scan, because clouds change their own fields, and teams stop reading the alerts within a week. This agent filters with named rules you can audit, auto-fixes only changes that can't cause an outage, and asks a named person to approve the rest. Key highlights: **Every alert or suppression explains itself:** each dropped difference names the rule that dropped it. **Checks its own work** by re-scanning after a fix instead of trusting that the write happened. **Found a hidden severity bug:** a publicly exposed production database was rated "high" instead of "critical" in 27 of 100 scenarios. Honest limitation/tradeoff: Tested on 100 seeded scenarios. Next: a real cloud account. Verified metrics: 1.000 precision vs 0.325 · 8.3 false alarms per scan eliminated · 26 tests.
